Departure35667032731

Delicious Saigon dishes
Sep 2026 • Couples
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I just ate at Doya Jjambbong and I was quite satisfied. Rich jjambbong, with a moderate spicy and fragrant flavor, piping hot broth, plenty of toppings, and fresh ingredients. Chewy noodles, very good with seafood.

Clean space, friendly staff, fast service. Korean-style flavors but still quite easy to eat, especially suitable for those who like spicy dishes and seafood noodles.

Overall the food quality is good, the portion size is reasonable, I will come back to try other dishes. 👍
